# Gold Standard Dog Training

Dog trainer in Golden Bay & Takaka, New Zealand — Warwick Marshall offers in-person obedience, recall, puppy training, reactivity, and rehabilitation coaching across Nelson Bays and the Tasman region.

## Book & contact

- [Book a session](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/book): Online booking for Golden Bay and Nelson Bays sessions (beach, town, home visit).
- [Contact](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/contact): Enquiry form — first conversation is free. Call/text 027 814 2222.
- [About Warwick Marshall](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/about): Method (Dog-Tantra / pack sensitivity), what sessions include, and pricing.

## Services

- [All services](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services): In-person coaching offers for real households — not a generic class syllabus.
- [Everyday obedience & manners](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/everyday-obedience): Sit, wait, heel, recall, and daily standards that hold under distraction.
- [Puppy training](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/puppy-training): Toilet training, biting/mouthing, crate routines, and early structure.
- [Leash training & recall](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/leash-recall-control): Stop pulling, lunging, and road fixation; build reliable recall.
- [Home manners & greetings](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/home-manners): Door manners, visitor greetings, settle, and calm thresholds.
- [Reactive dog / social calm](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/dog-social-calm): Dog-to-dog calm, leash reactivity, Controlled Confrontation with a balanced helper dog.
- [Dog rehabilitation](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/rehabilitation): Reactivity, anxiety, hard histories, and stuck behavioural patterns.
- [Owner coaching](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/services/owner-coaching): Private household sessions and elite coaching for lasting handler leadership.

## Service areas

- [Where we train](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas): Based in Takaka / Rangihaeata; serves Golden Bay and the wider Tasman region.
- [Golden Bay](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/golden-bay): Home service area — beaches, roads, and everyday distractions.
- [Takaka](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/takaka): Business base in Rangihaeata, Takaka.
- [Pohara](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/pohara): Coastal households — leash, recall, and holiday foot traffic.
- [Nelson Bays](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/nelson-bays): Wider Nelson Bays / Tasman coverage.
- [Motueka](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/motueka): Motueka-area households within Tasman coverage.
- [Richmond](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/areas/richmond): Richmond and nearby Tasman households.

## Free tools & guides (first-party)

- [Client Reference Guide](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/guide): Warwick’s method reference — corrections, leash work, access training, puppy phase, social needs.
- [Knowledge Exam](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/exam): Breed-aware owner exam or full trainer track.
- [Breed Analysis](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/intelligence): Compare breeds on intelligence and temperament; explore mix ranges.
- [What Kind of Dog Are You?](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/dog-personality): Temperament archetype quiz mapped to breed vibes.
- [Breed Finder](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/breed-finder): Match household lifestyle to breed candidates with honest caveats.
- [Dog Selector](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/dog-selector): Working/family job or breed mix — likely outcomes and cultivation by age.
- [Recommended equipment](https://goldstandarddogtraining.nz/equipment): Gentle Leader, Kong Classic, Carhartt 6ft leash — sizing and fit notes used in sessions.
